job.job_title: Full Stack Developer | Python (FastAPI) | React.js | Product based Co.
job.job_description:
Key Responsibilities:

Design, develop and maintain FastAPI backend and React frontend applications.
Build REST APIs, WebSockets, Redis, Celery, PostgreSQL and MQTT-based services.
Develop AI visualization dashboards and edge monitoring systems.
Optimize performance, reliability, security and maintainability.
Work with Docker, Linux, CI/CD, testing and deployment.
Collaborate across AI, C++, DevOps and Product teams.
Write clean, modular, documented code.

Qualifications

Bachelor's/Master's in Computer Science or equivalent.
2-4 years of Full Stack development.
Strong Python (FastAPI), React.js, JavaScript/TypeScript.
PostgreSQL, Redis, Celery, Docker, Linux.
REST APIs, WebSockets, Git and debugging skills.
